name: Bronwen

attributes.attribute: an obscure ancestral goddess of Wales
often conflated with the heroine Branwen
her name survives as a mountain in north Wales

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bronwen is an obscure ancestral goddess of Wales. Several writers link her with the later epic heroine Branwen. Others warn against that conflation. Her name may mean white-bosomed one. The name also survives as a mountain in north Wales.

okr.objective: Describe Bronwen, the obscure ancestral Welsh goddess.
key_results: Bronwen was an ancestral goddess of Wales.
Some writers merge her with the heroine Branwen.
Her name may mean white-bosomed one.
She lends her name to a mountain in north Wales.
